build_sac_trainer: build a SAC trainer with actor, critic, and value networks using normalization data
build_sac_serving_module: build a serving module from a trained SAC trainer for inference
configure_sac_actor_net: configure the SAC model with a GaussianFullyConnected actor network builder
configure_sac_critic_net: configure the SAC model with a FullyConnected critic network builder
configure_sac_value_net: configure the SAC model with an optional FullyConnected value network builder
